claims: The Terraform test still expects the old Slack title: alerts/rules/peg-rule-definitions.tftest.hcl:68-69 requires `$alert.Annotations.summary` and `$alert.Annotations.resolved_summary` in `peg_slack_title`, but the new title at peg-message-templates.tf:14 contains neither, so the required `ci` job will fail
The JS lint test at alert-rules-lint.test.mjs:1249 still passes only because the pager title (peg-message-templates.tf:64,68) contains those strings; it no longer guards the Slack title

An alert that fires straight out of an Error state loses its alert row (peg-alert-events.ts:109-110, :321): Error→Alerting is now `error-recovered-alerting` and `cycleKey` files it under the error cycle only, so no alert cycle opens and the breach row never appears; the later clear shows up alone, without "lasted" (:344-347). This is a regression from `base`
No test covers the Normal→Error→Alerting→Normal case (or Error→Pending)

Error→Pending recovery is never recorded (route.ts:43-56, peg-alert-events.ts:105-115): the route only requests `previous=Error` with `current=Normal` and `transitionKind` returns null for Error→Pending, so the "Grafana could not evaluate…" row stays open for up to 7 days while Grafana is healthy

A flapping data source can take down the whole feed (route.ts:63-64 with peg-alert-events.ts:148-153): each Error query has the same 1,000-row limit and hitting it fails the whole request, so the endpoint returns 502 and hides the real breach history

Error rows for rules without a price source say "Price source" (peg-alert-events.ts:230, :269): seven rule definitions have `source = ""` and their error rows read "Grafana could not evaluate the Price source Peg rule"
`includesAsset: false` is hardcoded, so Policy Rollover Stuck gets the detail "POLICY.", which its normal copy suppresses (peg-alert-copy.ts:270-273)
Docs out of date: docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:118-119 still say Slack titles show the icon plus the summary
Docs out of date: docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:132-133 say the history reads "only fired and resolved transitions", but it now also reads Error transitions
Alerting→Error→Normal leaves the alert open (pre-existing in `base`, not caused by this change)

1.why: peg-rule-definitions.tftest.hcl:68-69 still requires $alert.Annotations.summary/resolved_summary in peg_slack_title, but the new title at peg-message-templates.tf:14 has only icons; same as known 'Update the stale Terraform title assertion'

2.why: The old assertion now passes because of the VictorOps title, and its message was deliberately changed to 'pager titles'. The diff adds a separate assertion on the slackTitleTemplate slice that rejects Annotations.summary/resolved_summary, so the Slack title is still guarded

3.why: transitionKind maps Error→Alerting to error-recovered-alerting and cycleKey puts it under ':error', so no ':alert' cycle opens. The later Alerting→Normal goes to unpairedCleared and is shown alone with no 'lasted'. In base, Error→Alerting counted as 'raised' and paired with the clear

4.why: The new route.test.ts cases cover only Normal→Error→Normal(NoData) and Alerting→Error→Alerting. No test covers Normal→Error→Alerting→Normal or Error→Pending

5.why: errorStateHistoryUrl adds only previous=Error with current=Normal, and transitionKind returns null for Error→Pending; same as known 'Include recoveries that resume in Pending' / 'Pending recovery orphans error cycle'

6.why: Each Error URL inherits limit=1001, and parseStateFrameTransitions throws once a result has more than PEG_ALERTS_MAX_STATE_ROWS (1,000) rows. Promise.all plus the route's catch then returns 502 for the whole feed, so high-cardinality Error history hides the breach history

7.why: pegAlertSourceName('') returns 'Price source' and evaluationCause interpolates it; 7 definitions have source = "". Same as known 'Label source-less evaluation failures by rule'

8.why: evaluationCause hardcodes includesAsset: false, so the Policy Rollover Stuck rule (asset = "policy") gets detail 'POLICY.' from pegAlertAssetName. Its normal rolloverCause sets includesAsset: true to suppress that

9.why: docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:118-119 still says 'Slack titles use the severity icon plus that summary'; same as known 'Keep the Peg runbook aligned with the new title'

10.why: docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:132-133 says the backend 'reads only fired and resolved transitions', but route.ts now also queries current=Error and previous=Error, and the feed renders Error rows

11.why: Error→Normal gets the ':error' key, so the ':alert' cycle opened by the earlier Alerting is never closed and the breach stays open; same as known 'Error recovery leaves breach active' (peg-alert-events.ts:352)
